verdict.rationale: Kintsugi publishes a per-endpoint API reference generated from an OpenAPI spec, covering nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions and address suggestions. It also offers recipes such as the calculate-tax walkthrough, and its MCP server lets AI assistants query the docs and spec for code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (no in-browser 'try it' console or runnable examples), and probes of public OpenAPI paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive request execution in the reference, runnable code samples per endpoint, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
